c1.note: Bath & Body Works, Inc. (NYSE: BBWI) is the corporate entity that owns and operates the brand, per its own site and 10-K.

c2.note: Company says it became an independent public company in Aug 2021; no higher parent appears in the 10-K or elsewhere.

c4.note: Widely held public stock with about 25,000 record holders and no controlling parent.

c7.note: Board-approved name change was expected effective Aug 2, 2021 in connection with the separation.

c9.note: Victoria's Secret was spun off in Aug 2021 and L Brands continued as Bath & Body Works, Inc.

c10.note: Release says the new Victoria's Secret & Co. includes Lingerie, PINK and Beauty.

c12.note: The Aug 3, 2021 release launched Bath & Body Works as a standalone public company.

c13.note: 8-K says Bath & Body Works retains no ownership interest in Victoria's Secret.

c14.note: The 10-K confirms the common stock trades on the NYSE under BBWI.

c17.note: 10-K lists principal executive offices in Columbus, Ohio.

c19.note: 10-K cover states 201,134,265 shares as of March 6, 2026.

c20.note: 10-K for fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2026 is registered by Bath & Body Works, Inc., which is itself the publicly traded top-level company (no parent).

c21.note: 10-K signed and dated March 12, 2026; later filings are 10-Qs, so it remains the latest 10-K.

c22.note: 10-K uses 'we', 'our' and 'the Company' for Bath & Body Works, Inc.

c23.note: 10-K states Notes were issued by Bath & Body Works, Inc. (the 'Parent Company'), i.e. the top-level parent of the subsidiaries.

c24.note: No passage quoted, but the company's standard self-description is a global leader in personal care and home fragrance; consistent with known boilerplate.

c25.note: Specialty retail of personal care and home fragrance products is consistent with the company profile and 10-K.

c26.note: 10-K references 100% owned subsidiaries; Bath & Body Works, LLC and Brand Management are consistent with the Exhibit 21 subsidiary list, though not shown in the excerpt.

c27.note: Daniel Heaf is listed as CEO and Director; the 10-K signature page confirms it.

c28.note: Wikipedia navbox lists Victoria's Secret under 'Former'.

c29.note: Company states Bath & Body Works was founded in 1990.

c30.note: 10-K describes Bath & Body Works as the company's brand and business, with stores and e-commerce.

c4.note: BBWI is an independent NYSE-listed company. Institutional investors hold about 95% of its shares, and no one holds a controlling stake. A Nov 2026 search found no news of an acquisition or takeover (sources: sec.gov BBWI 10-Q for 2026-08-01; marketbeat.com holdings reports from 2026).

c9.note: In August 2021, L Brands spun off Victoria's Secret as a separate public company and renamed itself Bath & Body Works, Inc. (bbwinc.com/about-us; investors.bbwinc.com).

c14.note: The company still trades under the ticker BBWI, according to its 2026 SEC 10-Q and 8-K filings.

c16.note: The ticker changed from LB to BBWI with the 2021 name change. The 10-K for fiscal year ending 2026-01-31 lists common stock with a $0.50 par value on the NYSE.

c30.note: The 10-K for fiscal year ending 2026-01-31 describes the Bath & Body Works brand selling through company-operated stores and e-commerce sites (sec.gov bbwi-20260131.htm).
